title: Accept path-like values in the editor helper

change_shapes.description: The editor helper broadens its accepted filename type from strings to path-like objects.
The public editor entry point recognizes a single path-like object and wraps it as a one-item iterable.
A regression test covers both a single path-like filename and an iterable containing one.

title: Report a usage error when a conftest file is blocked as a plugin

change_shapes.description: The change log records an explicit usage error for attempts to block a conftest file as a plugin.
Plugin-argument handling rejects conftest-file names with a user-facing error.
A regression test checks the usage-error exit path and diagnostic.

title: Restore test compatibility with the current warning API

change_shapes.description: The development test constraint is widened to admit the current supported testing-framework major line.
A warning assertion adopts the current no-argument API form.

title: Continue client-certificate setup when peer verification is disabled

change_shapes.description: The change log records the client-certificate case when peer verification is disabled.
The disabled-verification branch configures the context but no longer returns before client-certificate setup.

title: Avoid a primary-key collision when a test group runs in reverse

change_shapes.description: A fixed primary-key value in a bulk-create regression is moved away from values that a database sequence may already have allocated.

title: Fix a metadata spelling error in the documentation hook

change_shapes.description: A documentation-hook comment corrects the spelling of metadata.

title: Keep the buffered reader in the caller

change_shapes.description: A documentation example keeps the buffered reader in the caller so unread bytes remain available after one decoded object.

title: Account for search statistics before suppressing empty JSON output

change_shapes.description: The change log records corrected summary statistics for JSON output.
Search statistics are accumulated before the early return that suppresses an empty JSON end record.
